name: Humeral Shaft Fracture
definition: Fracture of the humeral diaphysis, caused by direct trauma, falls or twisting mechanisms and associated with risk of radial nerve palsy.

typical: Possible wrist/finger extension weakness if radial nerve injured

investigations.MRI: CT only for selected complex extension into joints; MRI for pathological lesion when indicated.
investigations.radiographs: AP/lateral humerus including shoulder and elbow.

green: Immobilization then functional bracing for suitable patterns
amber: Surgery is selected for open, unstable, vascular, polytrauma or nonunion-risk cases.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Bhagna principles may complement rehabilitation after orthopedic stabilization.

patientEducation.summary: Fracture of the humeral diaphysis, caused by direct trauma, falls or twisting mechanisms and associated with risk of radial nerve palsy.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, breathing/swallowing difficulty, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
